description: Get an AI signal for one Polymarket market (by its slug) or the current trending markets, through AIProx (aiprox.dev): one POST /api/orchestrate with capability market-data, 50 sats, paid in Bitcoin Lightning (L402 or a LightningProx spend token). Informational only, not financial advice. Use it when the user asks about a specific Polymarket market or trending markets and agrees to pay.
